title: A listing in the Teme directory
description: listings/<vendor>/<name>.json: one file per package, named after its Composer name.

repository.description: The package's public GitHub repository, as https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.

kind.description: Whether the package is a plugin or a theme.

categories.description: One to three categories from categories.json, for the package's kind.

picked.description: Picked by the Teme team. Only maintainers set it to true.
